manufacturer.name: Garador
manufacturer.note: British garage door manufacturer, with a separate New Zealand arm at garador.co.nz that publishes its own owner's manuals. Both documentation indexes are registered as harvest targets. Recorded with no document records: search named the indexes and described what they cover - Up & Over, Sectional with L, N and Z track options, GaraRoll and Side Hinged - but surfaced no individual PDF URL on either domain, and a described document is not a document.
